label: Bible Study
prompt: The Jews had light, and _____, and joy, and honour.
verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
note: The turnaround after Haman's plot fails — light, gladness, joy, and honour, in four quick words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye _____.
verse: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
note: Jehoshaphat's pep talk at dawn before the battle: believe God and His prophets, and ye shall prosper.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let no corrupt _____ proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verse: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
note: 'Corrupt communication' is KJV for rotten talk — Paul's rule is only words that build people up.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of _____, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verse: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
note: 'Abba' is Aramaic for father, the word Jesus himself prayed in Gethsemane — the Spirit teaches adopted kids the family word.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And as it is _____ unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verse: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
note: One life, one death, then judgment — and verse 28 adds the good news: Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many.
